title: 16990 - 16990/P0606/001542
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kontrol Modülü / Elektronik Beyin (ECU/TCM) Donanımsal Arızalı
technicalNotes:
When P0606 is found in the M.Y. 2020 - 2022 NAR market Audi e-tron quattro, e-tron Sportback quattro and e-tron S quattro see TPI 2068931 (TSB 93-23-95): https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2023/MC-10231588-0001.pdf  NHTSA
Address 01: Engine controllers 4KE-907-558 and 4KE-907-558-C with SWLs under 0003 and one of the following symptom codes may be corrected after that flash update is performed: 38462, 39721, 32061, 32326, 40870, 29391
When a similar DTC (P060C) is found in the M.Y. 2019 – 2020 NAR market Audi e-tron quattro with 4KE-907-558 see TPI 2057853 (TSB 01-20-70) for a very similar concern.  It uses a different SVM code than the older models. https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10177298-0001.pdf NHTSA
